application_profile: unchanged strict UID/GID 1000, all capabilities zero, NNP 1, seccomp 2; readonly source/context/providers; no management socket
control_scope: Actual trusted closed management launch only; descriptor candidate itself grants no approval

source_descriptor_contract.execution: Every packet/control Python source is compiled only from its retained sealed FD; bootstrap itself executes through its inherited sealed read-only FD.
source_descriptor_contract.retention: All source and runtime FDs retained through role physical retirement; any identity change fails and retires.
source_descriptor_contract.runtime: Root-owned exact runtime manifest; source imports execute retained immutable bytes, native extension/ELF map device+inode and retained FD match exact approved runtime files.
